title: Wegleitung Natürliche Personen 2025

notes: Publication date not stated in the PDF. Standard deadline 15 March, 15 May for self-employed, farmers and certain partnerships. Written for paper forms; names TaxMe-Online for online filing.

title: Guide Personnes physiques 2025
publisher: Intendance des impôts du canton de Berne
why_needed: French version of the 2025 natural persons guide (preferred language)
notes: Title as read from the fetched text; check the cover page. States a 30-day objection (reclamation) period from notification that cannot be extended. Publication date not stated.

title: Wegleitung Natürliche Personen 2024 / 2025 (Änderungen)

title: Steuererklärung 2025 Natürliche Personen
why_needed: Printable form set for the 2025 natural persons return and annexes
notes: Form codes DT0001 to DT0006 and DT0008 present (DT0006 is professional costs 2025). Forms 7, 9 and 10 (real estate, self-employment, agriculture) are referenced but not included in this PDF.

title: Aktuelles aus Ihrer Steuerverwaltung: Wichtig zu wissen für Ihre Steuererklärung 2025
why_needed: Current official summary of filing channels, extension fees, 2025 deductions and 2026 prepayment changes
notes: Published January 2026 (day not stated). Extension fee schedule was read from a summary of this sheet; confirm against the PDF before relying on it. Mentions the AGOV login for natural persons.

title: Steuererklärung online einreichen via Dr. Tax (Sicht Treuhänder)

notes: Version 4/2025. Describes the taxpayer release via BE-Login or a signed release receipt. No list of approved software in this guide. A French version is described as existing but was not verified.

title: Dr. Tax Steuererklärungen: Häufige Fragen, Sicht Treuhänder/Treuhänderin
why_needed: States that only the taxpayer may release a return via BE-Login
notes: Page headers dated 2020 (08.09.2020 and 19.08.2020), older than the 4/2025 guide. Use for the release rule and absence of an approval list only.

why_needed: 2026 source tax tables for withholding on wages
notes: One PDF in German and French. Covers tariff groups A and H, B, C and G, with and without church tax. No validity start date stated.

title: Nachträgliche ordentliche Veranlagung (NOV), Aktuelles aus Ihrer Steuerverwaltung 2025
why_needed: Rules on who may request NOV from source tax, the deadline, irrevocability and submission
notes: Request due by 31 March of the following year. Deadline ends at deregistration when leaving Switzerland. No rectification deadline stated. No version number or publication date printed.

title: Antrag nachträgliche ordentliche Veranlagung (NOV) für Ansässige
why_needed: Request form for NOV by Swiss residents
notes: Form version 7.2025. Tax year field is blank, and a blank year means the previous year. Irrevocable once filed on time. Due 31 March of the following year. Send by email to nov.sv@be.ch or by post to Steuerverwaltung des Kantons Bern, Quellensteuer / NOV, Postfach, 3001 Bern.
